WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
baseline_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as baseline_value
  FROM status_averages
),
with_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    sa.brokrepstat,
    sa.avg_modelconf,
    bc.baseline_value
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline_calc bc
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    avg_modelconf,
    baseline_value
  FROM with_baseline
  WHERE avg_modelconf > baseline_value
),
mean_qualifying_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as mean_qualifying_value
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
  q.brokrepstat,
  q.avg_modelconf,
  q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_value,
  q.avg_modelconf / mq.mean_qualifying_value
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN mean_qualifying_calc mq
WHERE q.baseline_value IS NOT NULL
  AND mq.mean_qualifying_value IS NOT NULL
